name: list_topics
description: List all topics for Google Cloud Managed Service for Apache Kafka for a given project, location, and cluster.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of topics to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token, received from a previous `ListTopics` call.

parent.description: Required. The parent cluster whose topics are to be listed. Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/clusters/{cluster_id}
